description: A script for analyzing the usage of build-time variables defined in BoardConfig*.mk files and used by framework modules in an Android build environment.

methods.name: find_files
methods.description: Recursively finds files in specified folders matching a filter.

methods.name: find_board_config_mks
methods.description: Finds BoardConfig*.mk files in specified folders.

methods.name: find_makefiles
methods.description: Finds makefiles (*.mk or Makefile) in specified folders.

methods.name: find_system_module_makefiles
methods.description: Reads module-info.json to find makefiles of system modules.

methods.name: find_defined_variables
methods.description: Parses BoardConfig*.mk files to find defined variables excluding a whitelist.

methods.name: find_usage
methods.description: Counts usage of a variable in specified makefiles.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the analysis and outputs CSV report.
